description: Source code for the ImageRenderer class in the MigraDoc rendering library, responsible for rendering images in PDF documents, including handling image dimensions, cropping, and error cases.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering images within the MigraDoc PDF rendering process, including formatting, drawing, and error handling.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Prepares image file path, checks existence, and calculates image dimensions.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the actual rendering of the image or failure message.

methods.name: RenderFailureImage
methods.description: Draws a placeholder rectangle with an error message when image rendering fails.

methods.name: CalculateImageDimensions
methods.description: Calculates the dimensions of the image, including cropping and scaling, handling various image formats and errors.

methods.name: CreateXImage
methods.description: Creates an XImage object from a file path or base64 string.
